sentences.en: Muscular dystrophy is an incredibly rare, but extremely serious disease.
sentences.zh: 肌肉营养障碍是一种极其罕见但非常严重的疾病。

sentences.en: The child's poor diet led to growth dystrophy.
sentences.zh: 孩子的营养不良导致了生长发育迟缓。

sentences.en: Regular exercise can help prevent muscle dystrophy in older adults.
sentences.zh: 规律运动可以帮助预防老年人的肌肉萎缩。
